people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: “Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”
translations.bsb: O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.”
translations.kjv: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
translations.asv: O Jehovah God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember thy lovingkindnesses to David thy servant.
